Hiring
 **Senior Accountant** 
 to join our team at Neology PSquare TechSystems India (part of Neology Inc www.neology.com).
 



 Number of Open Positions – 1
 



 Experience \- 5\+ years
 



 Industry \- IT Product \& Services and IT Consulting
 



 Employment Type \- Full\-time
 



 Work Location \- Smart City, Kochi, Kerala
 



  





**Job Description** 




 The Senior Accountant serves as the accounting lead for Neology PSquare\-India, overseeing day\-to\-day accounting operations, supervising accounting staff, managing month\-end close activities, and supporting financial reporting requirements.
 



 This is a hands\-on leadership role requiring an experienced accounting professional who can quickly assume responsibility with minimal onboarding. The successful candidate will independently manage accounting operations, lead accounting meetings, drive process improvements, and ensure timely and accurate financial reporting.
 



 A key objective of this role is to strengthen the company internal accounting capabilities, and improve accounting processes.
 



 The position works closely with the U.S. Corporate Accounting, management, external advisors, and operational teams while maintaining internal ownership of accounting activities, documentation, and reporting support. The ideal candidate is a proactive problem solver with strong leadership, communication, analytical, and organizational skills who can effectively manage multiple priorities in a deadline\-driven environment.
 



  





**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES** 




  





**Accounting Leadership \& Team Management** 



* Lead the day\-to\-day accounting function and supervise accounting staff.
* Review accounting work, establish accountability, and support employee development.
* Lead accounting, month\-end close, and financial review meetings.



  





**Accounting Operations \& Financial Reporting** 



* Own the General Ledger, prepare and review journal entries, and maintain accurate accounting records
* Lead monthly, quarterly, and annual close activities, including accruals, prepaid expenses, depreciation, lease amortization, and intercompany entries
* Ensure all balance sheet accounts are reconciled monthly and books are closed timely and accurately.



  





**Revenue Recognition, Project Accounting \& Analysis** 



* Apply revenue recognition policies, review contracts billing arrangements, and project documentation
* Perform project accounting, project costing, profitability analysis, labor cost analysis, and financial reporting
* Analyze COGS, payroll, subcontractor costs, R\&D expenses, and operating expenses.








**Accounting Remediation \& Process Improvement** 



* Bring backlogged bookkeeping and accounting records current.
* Review historical accounting records and supporting schedules.
* Coordinate significant accounting adjustments, corrections, and reclassifications with Corporate Accounting
* Strengthen internal accounting capabilities, streamline accounting processes, and improve documentation standards.








**Fixed Assets, Procurement \& Payroll** 



* Perform capitalization analysis and maintain fixed asset, depreciation, and lease schedules.
* Coordinate asset inventories and validate asset classifications.
* Oversee accounting aspects of purchasing, Purchase Orders, Sales Orders, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, customer billing, and payroll accounting.
* Maintain knowledge of India payroll compliance requirements.








**Systems, Intercompany \& Reporting** 



* Serve as the primary Zoho Books administrator and lead system optimization initiatives
* Manage India\-U.S. intercompany accounting activities and support transfer pricing and markup calculations
* Support India statutory reporting and U.S. parent\-company reporting requirements.








**Internal Controls \& Segregation of Duties** 



* Establish and maintain accounting controls, approval workflows, and documentation standards
* Implement appropriate segregation of duties across purchasing, billing, payroll, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, financial reporting, and approval functions.
* Evaluate existing workflows and strengthen governance, accountability, and process controles.








**Corporate \& External Coordination** 



* Work closely with Corporate Accounting to ensure compliance with accounting policies, reporting standards, and corporate requirements.
* Coordinate with external Chartered Accountants, auditors, payroll providers, tax advisors, and other consultants.
* Ensure accounting records, reconciliations, and supporting documentation remain organized, accurate, and audit\-ready.








**Professional Competencies** 



* Strong knowledge of Indian accounting practices and working knowledge of U.S. GAAP; exposure to multinational reporting environments is preferred.
* Strong understanding of accounting principles and the ability to apply them to complex transactions, reconciliations, revenue recognition, financial analysis, and accounting classifications.
* Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, and organizational skills
* High attention to detail, accuracy, and quality of work.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, meet strict deadlines, and perform effectively in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong written and verbal communication and interpersonal skills.
* Proactive, self\-motivated, and results\-oriented with a strong sense of ownership and accountability
* Demonstrated ability to work independently, exercise sound judgment, and take ini
* Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a cross\-functional team
* Strong leadership skills with the ability to supervise staff, lead meetings, drive accountability, and implement process improvements.

title: Report Advisor-Financials Product Line

 Finance
   

  

**Sub\-function:** 
 Reporting \& Data Analytics – FP\&A
   

  

**Duration:** 
 Permanent
   

  

**The opportunity**
 The Report Advisor reports to the product line’s senior report advisor and focuses primarily on the end\-user and key influential stakeholder groups who either use or have an interest in the solutions. Together with the Product Line lead the Report Advisors represents the face of one reporting product line within the Reporting and Data Analytics sub\-function (R\&DA). The R\&DA ensures that EY is keeping pace with the many analytical and technological changes taking place in the business world, evolving our tools and the way we consume information, to best support the client serving as well as corporate responsibilities in a rapidly changing business world.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Work hand\-in\-hand with the senior report advisor as well as functional and technical support teams

* Good presenter and trainer – act as an influencer or sales person
* Overarching knowledge around the product line offering, EY’s business concepts and rules as well as the strategic objectives
* Establishes and maintains good relationships within the R\&DA, Finance, other functions and Operational Leads as well as stakeholder groups

**What We Look For**
* Ability to influence and inspire change
* Global and inclusive mindset
* Personality with confidence and credibility
* Innovative mindset being open to new ideas and promoting team members to think outside the box
* Good knowledge of business processes and end\-user needs and their ways of managing their responsibilities
* Challenging customers insightfully to improve process, approach or results
* Apply a deep understanding of customer needs to identify critical outcomes, pain points, barriers to success, and changes in expectations or scope
* Proposing options and making recommendations based on stakeholder feedback
* Driving change efforts and adoption through building and maintaining relationships with end\-users, stakeholders and leadership
* Resolving competing priorities respectful and effectively
* Ability to work both autonomously to achieve project goals, as well as in a team environment with limited direction and supervision
* Using appropriate resources to increase team strengths and decrease costs while meeting deadlines

**Experience**
**To qualify for the role you must have**
* 5 plus years of experience in a finance or markets/business development department or change management programs

**What We Offer**
 The R\&DA sub\-function is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We support customers in all EY locations and across many functions and Service Lines. R\&DA colleagues are in various locations across the Globe with concentration in US, UK, Germany, France, Poland and India. From accountants and programmers to people with consulting, change management or data scientist background, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span various disciplines. In the R\&DA, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well\-known brands and technologies.
